content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Law from a recognized University/Institute. Experience: More than 5 years and upto 7 years of experience of dealing with legal matters in a government or Public Sector Undertaking or Semi-Government or autonomous or statutory organisation or recognized institution or councils or registered societies, OR 5 years experience as a legal practitioner, OR Retired Judicial Officer or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 65 years Other conditions: Computer Literacy is compulsory. Should have good communication and interpersonal skills. The Consultant needs to arrange own accommodation facility at nearby places. Desirable: Master degree in Law from a recognized University/Institute.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial period of six months or till appointment of a candidate on deputation, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How Will PPQS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Interview Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through e-mail and required to bring original documents at the time of interview.

Send the application in hard copy or by email to [email protected] within 10 days from the date of issue/publishing of the notice. Email it on or before 9 November 2026.
